passages.provision_quote: during the first ten (10) weeks of postfertilization age of the fetus, if: (A) the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest;
passages.note: Same section also exempts, before viability/20 weeks, abortions necessary to prevent a serious health risk or save the mother's life, or for a lethal fetal anomaly.
Official digest page; it names Sen. Susan Glick as author, not Garten, so it shows no act by Garten.

rows.reasoning: Garten voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill. Its operative section bans abortion except for a listed set of circumstances including that "the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest" and, before viability/20 weeks, a serious health risk or threat to the mother's life or a lethal fetal anomaly -- matching the rung that bans abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life.
